notes:
A written account of one's own life. Composed of {自|じ} (self) and {伝|でん} (biography). Unlike a memoir, which may focus on select episodes, a {自伝|じでん} typically covers the author's entire life chronologically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自伝|じでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: write an autobiography
- {自伝|じでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: publish an autobiography
- {自伝|じでん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧: autobiographical novel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{伝記|でんき}→伝記：04069_denki⟧: biography — written by someone else about the subject
- {回顧録|かいころく}: memoir — may cover only part of one's life
- ⟦{評伝|ひょうでん}→評伝：25611_hyouden⟧: critical biography — includes evaluation and analysis
